item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Purchase order mapping available in Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace purchase order mapping is now generally available. It lets organizations allocate Microsoft invoices, including Marketplace purchases, to support accounting and reconciliation of cloud and AI spend.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace is now a new channel for discovering, evaluating, and purchasing Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents. The availability applies to Dragon Copilot customers in the United States.

  • Source: Azure Updates
